paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.81% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.41%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.03%). Brent crude changed +6.24% to 116.72. Gold changed -4.14% to 4,007.8999. Bitcoin changed -2.11% to 80,124.3906. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of -2.16%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+10.66%) and Ares Management (+8.74%) moved the most.
